svg.title: What each recipe buys: mean rounds survived on the Endless rack
svg.desc: Horizontal bars, 3,000 simulated runs each. Exact union: 3 4 5 -> 3-5: 17.9; Endless today (no kiln): 20; Kanchan, kiln holds 3: 21.4; Kanchan, kiln holds 2 (proposed): 22.8; Kanchan, kiln holds 1: 25.1; Kanchan, instant: 24.8; Endless at capacity 11 (no kiln): 24.6; Seed recipes, instant: 26.8. Reference lines at 20.0 (Endless today) and 24.6 (Endless at capacity 11, which the repo balance test already fails).

text.font-family: 'EB Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
